ruling.recommended_action: Refund SGD 4.55 to the rider by Ryde voucher for the unexempted detour distance on this RydeTAXI trip; note the driver's RD-1 breach. Traffic corroboration was only a band-2 record (RD-4(b)), which supports but does not by itself exempt the segment, so no account flag is added (profile shows no prior upheld route dispute).

segment_findings.reason: GPS divergence from the quoted route between ~09:10 and ~09:27 (southward loop through 103.81–103.82, reaching ~1.267/103.816 before rejoining near 1.2804,103.8277), ~3.2 km extra; no traffic-incident fact and only a band-2 speed record, which under RD-4(b) is corroborative only and does not exempt; no chat agreement (RD-3/RD-5). Non-exempt RD-1 breach → RD-2 partial refund.

rejected_claims.reason: RD-4 requires a traffic-incident fact on the substituted optimal segment (m_from_route ≤ 300 m, reported_at before the detour). Only a band-2 speed band exists, and RD-4(b) says a band record alone does not exempt (G3 pending). Driver's flooding claim is unsupported by incident data.

The 7 km gap between quote and meter is not entirely detour: RD-2 refunds only the unexempted segment's extra_km × per-km rate and excludes the map-matching/longer-route residual (≤0.25 km class) and the non-detour portion.
